review.description: Host subscription verification, stable signed delivery identities, retry, refresh and expiry remain unchanged. GitHub review-notification polling is a separate upstream concern and keeps its existing configurable interval.
review.implementation: Reviewed githubPollSeconds and SyncNotifications: existing120-second default and separate notification gate remain; new repository/detail fields do not enter subscription signing or delivery state. No internal/events implementation changed.
review.tests: Read TestSubscriptionVerificationRetryDedupRefreshAndExpiry: callback signatures verify, duplicate subscription reuses identity, failed delivery retries the same event ID, acknowledged delivery does not repeat, expired subscription is silent and unsubscribe is idempotent. New GitHub notification cadence test proves repository/detail values do not delay an independently due poll.
